text: A soft backdrop for a bold idea. This is the kind of colour I would use behind a portfolio hero.
Pick a palette, preview the layout and bring the background into a project. A simple workflow makes all the difference.
Subtle grain and a little glow can give a presentation cover so much character.
The small details matter: a quiet space for the headline, a little light around the product and colours that sit well together.
One composition, a different palette, a whole new mood. That is a lovely starting point for exploring a visual direction.
A background should make room for the content. Soft blends are a useful place to start.
A little colour goes a long way when the rest of the layout is kept simple.
Previewing the same background on a card and a full page helps me imagine where it belongs.
From a wide cover to a portrait graphic, it is useful to see how a composition changes with the crop.
